t0285-01.gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
t0285-01.rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

t0285-02.gloss: A personal account or object records an intervention that left part of the account missing.
t0285-02.rival_reading: The waterline could document the spread of a farm chemical washed into the building.
